title: Q2 Private Deployments: Upgrade Taxonomy, Risk Buckets, and OKR-mapped Milestones
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Objective: Produce a prescriptive Quarterly roadmap artifact that defines an upgrade taxonomy for Private/VPC/on-prem deployments, maps each upgrade type to risk buckets and rollback playbooks, and links milestones to measurable OKRs. Scope: taxonomy (hotfix, patch, minor, major, migration), risk buckets (low/medium/high/regulated), standard rollback steps, per-type acceptance criteria, and a dependency heatmap for infra, console, and runtime changes. Deliverables: 1) Taxonomy doc with examples and upgrade windows; 2) Risk bucket matrix with required approvals and estimated downtime; 3) OKR mapping spreadsheet tying each milestone to an objective and success metric; 4) Cutover and rollback playbooks per bucket; 5) Acceptance criteria and e2e QA checklist; 6) Customer communication templates and runbook for support. Success metrics: upgrade success rate >= 99% for minor/patch, <30 min mean recovery time for failed upgrades, customer-reported incidents <= 1 per 100 upgrades, and 80% of targeted enterprise customers pre-approved for scheduled windows. Stakeholders: PM (Sofia Martinez), Eng leads (Dmitri Koval, Leila Hassan), Security (Arjun Patel), Support (Maya Chen), Solutions Eng (Oliver Reyes). Key milestones and timeline: - By 2026-03-12: draft taxonomy and risk buckets (this ticket) - 2026-03-26: review with Security & Eng (design review) - 2026-04-09: finalize playbooks and OKR mapping - 2026-04-30: publish customer-facing runbook and start partner onboarding - 2026-05-15: ship release bundle and run first scheduled upgrades. Links: Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/private-upgrade-taxonomy (draft), Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1UpgradeTaxonomy (OKR spreadsheet), GitHub RFCs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/624, Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/private-upgrades/overview. Out-of-scope: major migration automation work, on-prem installer overhaul (tracked in separate initiative).
